en: Sepia-toned photograph showing a busy city gate with two large arched entrances in an old North African town. People in traditional clothing walk and ride donkeys through the gate into a narrow street lined with buildings and small market stalls. Along the top of the wall are crenellations. At the bottom of the image is printed caption text identifying the location and the specific gate.
